# ADR 0003: Deduplicated alerts by scenario, subject and window

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** AML transaction monitoring

## Context

Re-running a scenario must not flood analysts with duplicates.

## Decision

Unique key on (scenario, subject, window); insert with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING.

## Consequences

Idempotent runs.

## Alternatives considered

Application-side dedup.
